question: Who among the following won the 2020 Pulitzer Prize for his book of fiction ‘The Nickel Boys’?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Colson Whitehead.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Nickel Boys **won the Pulitzer Prize written by **Colson Whitehead.**
 
• "The Nickel Boys," is based on the true story of the School for Boys, a now-closed reform school in Florida.
 
• The Major theme in the **Nickel Boys is Trauma.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
